title: iNaturalist Observation Burst After Rain
dataSources: iNaturalist observations (`inat:observation`), moth trap sessions (`mothtrap:session`), bat detections (`batdetector:pass`), and trail-cam label events (`trailcam:label`).
app: Backyard biodiversity telemetry from iNaturalist exports, moth-trap image batches, AudioMoth bat detectors, and trail-camera AI labeling pipelines sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=inat:observation
| search observation_id=*
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as observations by _time rain_window
| sort - _time
description: Tracks iNaturalist observation bursts after rain over time and breaks it out by rain window.
value: Post-rain bursts help you see whether the best fieldwork windows are matching how you actually go outside.
implementation: Send iNaturalist observation bursts after rain events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1d granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of iNaturalist observation bursts after rain by rain window.
grandmaExplanation: It nudges how iNaturalist observation bursts after rain changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
